text: dsh-wsl-im 是把飞书、企业微信、钉钉、QQ、Slack、Discord、Telegram 和 Mattermost 消息接入 DSH agent 的即时通讯桥接插件。插件启动后按配置建立平台适配器，收到聊天消息时为每个平台和聊天创建独立 DSH 会话，并把 agent 回复送回原聊天；它还登记平台工作区、处理 /help、/reset、/status 命令，并提供 im_status 工具查看适配器状态。适合希望从常用团队聊天工具远程向 DSH 发送问题并接收回复的用户，也支持本机 mock HTTP 适配器。启用实际平台需配置相应机器人凭证；飞书适配器另需 SDK。

dsh-wsl-im connects Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk, QQ, Slack, Discord, Telegram, and Mattermost to DSH agents. It keeps separate conversations per platform chat, returns replies there, and provides /help, /reset, /status, and im_status. Enabled platforms need bot credentials; Feishu also needs its SDK.

dsh-wsl-im 的功能「消息桥接」：从支持的平台接收聊天消息，交给 DSH agent 处理，再将回复发送回发起消息的聊天。。通过已启用的平台适配器接收消息或调用状态工具；输入为聊天消息或状态请求，输出为 agent 回复或当前状态。
dsh-wsl-im 的功能「独立聊天会话」：按平台和聊天标识管理独立的 DSH 聊天会话，避免同一平台所有聊天共享一条会话。。通过已启用的平台适配器接收消息或调用状态工具；输入为聊天消息或状态请求，输出为 agent 回复或当前状态。
dsh-wsl-im 的功能「平台工作区登记」：启动时为各即时通讯平台创建工作区目录并登记到 DSH 工作区列表。。通过已启用的平台适配器接收消息或调用状态工具；输入为聊天消息或状态请求，输出为 agent 回复或当前状态。
dsh-wsl-im 的功能「状态与会话命令」：在聊天中响应 /help、/reset、/status，并提供 im_status 工具查看适配器状态。输入命令或状态请求，输出帮助、会话状态或适配器信息。
dsh-wsl-im 使用前须知：实际连接平台需提供对应机器人凭证；未启用适配器不会建立平台连接，飞书还需安装其 SDK。

dsh-wsl-im README · Architecture：Not in `install.sh`. Wire behavior follows vendor docs.

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  chats["Feishu / WeCom / DingTalk / QQ / Slack / Discord / Telegram"] --> im["dsh-wsl-im"]
  im --> ws["one workspace per IM"]
  im --> agents["ctx.agents"]

dsh-wsl-im README · Architecture：Each IM gets `~/.dsh/im-workspace/{feishu,wecom,dingtalk,qq,slack,discord,telegram,mattermost}`, registered on plugin start. One session per chat, not one session for the whole platform. Suite diagram: [dsh-wsl-kit](https://github.com/173787247/dsh-wsl-kit#how-the-pieces-fit). This plugin is **0.3.7** (optional, not in install.sh).

dsh-wsl-im README · Adapters：| Adapter | Mode | Creds |
|---------|------|-------|
| `feishu` | Long connection | `FEISHU_APP_ID` / `FEISHU_APP_SECRET` |
| `wecom` | 智能机器人 WSS | `WECOM_BOT_ID` / `WECOM_BOT_SECRET` |
| `dingtalk` | Stream | `DINGTALK_CLIENT_ID` / `DINGTALK_CLIENT_SECRET` |
| `qq` | Official Gateway | `QQ_APP_ID` / `QQ_APP_SECRET` |
| `slack` | Socket Mode | `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` (`xoxb-`) / `SLACK_APP_TOKEN` (`xapp-`) |
| `discord` | Gateway WSS | `DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN` (+ optional `DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID`) |
| `telegram` | Long-poll `getUpdates` | `TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN` (+ optional `TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME`) |
| `mattermost` | Outgoing Webhook + Bot REST | `MATTERMOST_URL` / `MATTERMOST_TOKEN` (+ optional webhook path/port) |
| `mock` | Local HTTP | `DSH_IM_MOCK=1` → `POST http://127.0.0.1:18999/mock` |
dsh-wsl-im README · Adapters：Enable with `DSH_IM_FEISHU=1` / `DSH_IM_SLACK=1` / `DSH_IM_DISCORD=1` / `DSH_IM_TELEGRAM=1` / `DSH_IM_MATTERMOST=1` (etc.) or `adapters.*.enabled: true` in patch config.

text: dsh-wsl-im README · WeCom proxy：`openws.work.weixin.qq.com` often needs `HTTPS_PROXY`/`HTTP_PROXY`. The adapter uses `https-proxy-agent` (`ws` ignores `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY`). One Bot = one live WS — stop any other client on the same Bot while testing.

dsh-wsl-im README · Discord / Telegram notes：- **Discord:** enable Message Content Intent; guild messages require @bot (set `DISCORD_APPLICATION_ID` or wait for READY). CDN downloads honor `HTTPS_PROXY`.
- **Telegram:** outbound long-poll only (no webhook). Groups need `@bot` when `TELEGRAM_BOT_USERNAME` is set.

dsh-wsl-im README · Security：Empty `allowedUserIds` = everyone. Set a whitelist before exposing bots. IM input can drive tools on the host.
